truth.why: A container Ken started two days ago listens on 8931 and appears in neither the manifest nor any work item. Healthy, not urgent, but the record is now wrong: handoff so a WI gets filed. This is Ken's own example of the check-and-balance duty.

task: Scheduled check, 03:00 UTC. Reconcile what is actually listening on kubsdb against the k-homelab manifest and report.

report.evidence:
Manifest lists: klams(8710), korg(8720), kfdc(8740), prometheus(9090), grafana(3000), postgresql(5432), registry(5000), nginx(443).
Actual listening on kubsdb: 5432, 8720, 8710, 8740, 9090, 3000, 5000, 443, 8931 (kbeacon), 22 (sshd).
report.finding: The services on kubsdb are generally in reconciliation with the manifest, but there is one undocumented service listening on port 8931: 'kbeacon'. SSH (port 22) is also present as expected for host access.
report.next_step: Update the k-homelab manifest to include the 'kbeacon' service on kubsdb port 8931.
